name: Odd Tangent-Polygon Classes and Complements
definition: For $m\ge2$, take the $2m+1$ lines tangent to the unit circle at the regular-polygon normals $v_j=(\cos(2\pi j/(2m+1)),\sin(2\pi j/(2m+1)))$. Let $H_{2m+1}$ be their strict sign-word class and $C_{2m+1}=\{0,1\}^{2m+1}\setminus H_{2m+1}$.
parameters: Integer $m\ge2$; $H_{2m+1}$ has rank two and $C_{2m+1}$ has rank $2m-2$.
properties: Both classes are convexly realizable and maximum, and both shores are dismantlable. Their decomposition levels are $\kappa(H_{2m+1})=1$ and $\kappa(C_{2m+1})=m-1$. In particular, $|H_7|=29$, $|C_7|=99$, $|H_9|=46$, and $|C_9|=466$; the heptagon complement has level two and the nonagon complement level three.
